beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Coherence Pressure examines a mistake that can survive accurate individual sentences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An explanation joins observations more strongly than the available evidence allows.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book reconstructs a documented conversation that turned two childhood behaviours into one theory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can inspect the original exchange, the correction, and the proposed research programme.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its question is how to preserve useful synthesis without manufacturing a connection.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A parent described a child wanting an unwanted app removed from a tablet.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same child could keep watching short videos as their format became repetitive.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Asked about a connection, the model organized both around the cost of ignoring.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That memorable comparison gave a shared explanation more weight than the evidence supported.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book distinguishes a common descriptive language from a demonstrated common mechanism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: After the parent's challenge, the model separated avoidance from continued exploration of possible rewards.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The comparison remained possible, but a shared mechanism had not been demonstrated.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book then turns its scrutiny on the name given to this mistake.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Coherence pressure remains a working hypothesis, which existing concepts might already explain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That second risk makes the book more than a collection of model failures.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its proposed research programme compares source material with the connections added by an explanation.
